🔔 Join our community for news, updates and exclusive rewards!

⚔️ ANIME CHRONICLES ⚔️
Max Level: 100

Fight through story arcs, collect anime-inspired fighters and climb the ranked ladder. Fast combo combat, flashy ultimates, parries and executes. Gear up with artifacts to push every build further.

🌀 Spiral Abyss: 10 floors of scaling challenges
💎 Artifact Domains: farm artifact sets and enhance them to build every fighter your way
🏆 Ranked 1v1 & 2v2: reach Diamond to unlock an exclusive Mythic fighter
👹 World bosses roaming the islands
🎟️ Battle Pass, daily quests, login and playtime rewards

💻 PC   📱 Mobile   🎮 Mobile

⚠️ Servers may shut down briefly for updates and bug fixes.
👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite so you don't miss the next update!
